for_ai: You were handed the Project Pulse link. This manifest is the underlying logic map. Each tool has a panel_source_url (the interactive implementation, plain browser JavaScript, fetch it and read it) and a component_source (the recovered/original software it builds on). depends_on lists the globals a panel source needs. To reuse a tool as a dependency, fetch its panel source and provide the listed globals. Shared libs live under pulse-tools/. The dashboard page itself is assembled by build_pulse_v2.py from pulse-v2/dashboard.js, pulse-v2/tools/*.js, and verbatim component sources.

name: MOOR Project Pulse

build.description: Assembles pulse-dashboard.html from the mockup skeleton, dashboard.js (component inventory), tools/*.js (interactive panels), and verbatim recovered component sources. Nothing is modified; panel code is additive.

seed-rng.note: Deterministic named streams. Every procedural tool depends on this.

moorworld.note: Canonical world/planet data: 8 sectors, 57 systems, 254 planets.

palettes.note: Procedural material/color tables keyed by planet type.

moor-wasm.note: Real Rust intent compiler compiled to WASM. Reference only; production is js-create-pipeline.

tools.label: MOOR Atlas
tools.what_it_does: Holographic terrain map with coordinates, places, land claims, and terrain-aware routes.
tools.honest_limits: Local 400 m sector; device-local saves. Claims are annotations, route playback is a preview, and codes need a world seed. No live ownership, multiplayer, or collision routing.
tools.api: window.MoorAtlas: getWorld, setWorld, sample, selectPoint, planRoute

tools.label: Living Garden Lab
tools.what_it_does: Grow eight plant families. Compare versions. Export real meshes.
tools.honest_limits: Art-directed procedural meshes, not biological growth simulation. Water changes morphology and garden mix. No production planet integration, leaf textures, or automatic LOD. Wind is visual; OBJ exports rest geometry.

tools.label: Planet Workshop
tools.what_it_does: Explore terrain, rivers, and plants. Experimental revision.
tools.honest_limits: Experimental terrain. Plant visuals are provisional and need replacement. Coarse runoff is not full physical erosion. Not in production MOOR.

tools.label: Terrain sculpting
tools.what_it_does: Generate land, shape it, and save it.
tools.honest_limits: No built-in renderer â the 2D heightmap painter in this panel is new panel code, copied from the proven pattern in the previous dashboard. Save/load uses the component’s own strict pack/unpack.

tools.label: Detailed terrain
tools.what_it_does: Draw ridges, roughness, and small ground detail.
tools.honest_limits: The component is shader functions only â the host page (canvas, compile, controls) is panel code copied from its two working hosts. Brush-edit uniforms never had a UI before this panel. No save format for edits exists in the component; exporting them is panel-owned.

tools.label: City geometry builder
tools.what_it_does: Build 3D shapes and give them materials.
tools.honest_limits: Materials 20 (blimp marquee) and 21 (billboard) need texture painters that were not recovered â they render flat grey here, labeled honestly. No save/load in the component; the shape list is panel state.

tools.label: STRUCT Â· building engine
tools.what_it_does: Seeded walls â rooms â buildings, with matching collision.
tools.honest_limits: Engine is data + math, no renderer. The live proof panel runs determinism, collision-parity, takeoff, and diagonal-miter checks in-page.

tools.label: Struct Builder
tools.what_it_does: Draw walls at any angle. Super easy 3D building.
tools.honest_limits: Sconces float at fixed height (no wall-mounting yet); table lamps assume a surface.

tools.label: Struct X-Ray
tools.what_it_does: DEV â see through buildings to their structure and their volumes.
tools.honest_limits: Layer routing classifies emitted boxes by material color; peel is a shader discard. Per-material mÂ² not exposed by the engine (total surface only).

tools.label: Struct Prefabs
tools.what_it_does: Furnished prefab showcase: 7 buildings, floor plans, volume manifests.
tools.honest_limits: Furniture placement is seeded-decorous, not interior-designed; pieces never overlap walls but are not arranged with designer intent.

tools.label: Dual-mode box
tools.what_it_does: One box call: render mesh or collision volumes.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. The solids branch is verbatim mesh-builder; the ball physics is panel demo code.

tools.label: Micro-relief
tools.what_it_does: Scrub terrain micro-detail from smooth to jagged.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. The GLSL is verbatim field.glsl; the orbit camera and UI are panel demo code.

tools.label: Seed breeding
tools.what_it_does: Breed visuals like a garden.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. The codec is verbatim seed-codec; the art families are panel demo code.

tools.label: Land claim
tools.what_it_does: Walk the grid. Claim plots. Build.
tools.honest_limits: Prototype: all logic is panel demo code. Currency, pricing, upkeep, and the free-build vs describe paths are open questions, listed in the demo’s ? panel.

tools.label: Glass map
tools.what_it_does: Holographic laser-etched terrain map.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. Height field is verbatim terrain-field GLSL; the glass/contour shader and overlay UX are panel demo code.

tools.label: Grid coords
tools.what_it_does: Every point in the universe gets a code.
tools.honest_limits: The codec is new panel code written for this component (window.GridCoords). Strict validation, never throws.

tools.label: Transit
tools.what_it_does: Book a ride. Arrive exactly on time.
tools.honest_limits: TransitContract is new panel code written for this component. Per-vehicle path curves; terminal sample is exactly the destination.

tools.label: Pad Garden
tools.what_it_does: Grow seeded ambience from the ambience-engine.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. ambContext/ambTone/ambPad/ambDrop/ambWash/ambDrone/ambBuild are verbatim ambience.js; the pad UI and playhead are panel demo code.

tools.label: Spell Siege
tools.what_it_does: Survive director-spawned waves with spell blasts.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. createSpawnDirector/update/pickType are verbatim spawn-director.js; spell renderers lifted from tool-wonder.js 2D types (particle-pack.mjs is GPU-atlas data, not 2D-usable).

tools.label: Perf Playground
tools.what_it_does: Watch the perf-governor adapt a particle storm.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. createGovernor is verbatim tool-perf.js; the particle field and stress burn are panel demo code.

tools.label: Maze Runner
tools.what_it_does: Drive the polar maze, grab all 5 rings.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. mazeWalls/mazeBlocked and createVehicle/stepVehicle are verbatim recovered code; the 2D renderer and checkpoints are panel demo code.

tools.label: Planet Dossier
tools.what_it_does: Swipe the seeded universe, read every planet.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. Generation/materials/climate/species/summary/findByAddress are verbatim moorworld.js; the card UI is panel demo code.

tools.label: Spawn Warp
tools.what_it_does: Morph the spawn flat to circular.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. stationPose/curveSpawnWing/uncurveSpawnWing are verbatim spawn-layout.mjs; the morph UI is panel demo code.

tools.label: Creature Lab
tools.what_it_does: Breed softbody creatures from genomes.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. Genome trait definitions are verbatim tool-creatures.js; the spring-ring renderer is verbatim tool-wonder.js creature; breeding math mirrors seed-codec.

tools.label: Goo Lab
tools.what_it_does: Melt metaball goo with real smooth-min.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. smin is verbatim tool-creatures.js; blob drift and glow follow tool-wonder.js metaball; the field rasterizer is panel demo code.

tools.label: Terrain Stack
tools.what_it_does: Real terrain-core plus toggleable math layers.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. generate/brush/pack/unpack are verbatim terrain-core.mjs; ridge/terrace follow tool-pipeline.js layer math; crater/river are seeded panel additions.

tools.label: sign shop
tools.what_it_does: Paint real moor billboards from your text.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. Paint routines verbatim from dev-billboards.mjs, balance-billboard.mjs, tablet-spawn-guide.mjs; the shop UI is panel demo code.

tools.label: palette mixer
tools.what_it_does: Paint planet palettes onto a landscape.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. PTEX/MAT tables verbatim from tool-palettes.js; the landscape painter is panel demo code.

tools.label: sculpt playground
tools.what_it_does: Sculpt a real moor heightfield by finger.
tools.honest_limits: Showcase embedding the live demo. generate/brush/pack/unpack verbatim terrain-core.mjs; the isometric renderer is panel demo code.

tools.label: Universe explorer
tools.what_it_does: Browse sectors, systems, planets, and zones.
tools.honest_limits: The component is data only â no renderer. The tree browser is new panel code over its query API. Prose summaries exist for planets only.

tools.label: Planet color sets
tools.what_it_does: Ten coordinated color sets for planet types.
tools.honest_limits: Pure data â no renderer and no edit model. The planet preview and the temporary-experiment overrides are panel code, clearly labeled as panel state, not component behavior.

tools.label: Ambient sound generator
tools.what_it_does: Create repeatable background soundscapes.
tools.honest_limits: Recipes are fixed cards â no knobs beyond seed, recipe, and length. No audio export in the component. The waveform is panel code drawn from the real rendered samples.

tools.label: Enemy wave director
tools.what_it_does: Choose enemies, wave timing, and difficulty.
tools.honest_limits: No fixed wave schedule to display (swarms are random-timed) and no explicit difficulty number â the panel derives a difficulty readout from the real interval/batch/stat curves and labels it as derived.

tools.label: Automatic graphics quality
tools.what_it_does: Reduce detail when frame times get too high.
tools.honest_limits: It only reports a quality number â applying it (fewer particles, lower resolution) is the host’s job. Thresholds are hardcoded in the component. The quality-over-time chart is a panel-side sample buffer.

tools.label: Plant generator
tools.what_it_does: Grow the planet’s plants from a seed.
tools.honest_limits: The plant shapes are the real builders from the planet demo (run against a minimal geometry shim â no THREE.js here). The orbit camera, ground, and this wind sway are panel viewing code; the real placement shader is planet-field-specific.

tools.label: Generator pipeline inspector
tools.what_it_does: See inside the terrain generator, add layers.
tools.honest_limits: The base pipeline is the untouched component. Added layers are panel composition â real seeded math, but not part of the component.

tools.label: Moor Canvas
tools.what_it_does: The mixing bench: pick two parts, say what they should become, mix them into something new.
tools.honest_limits: The preview is a procedural composition sketch, not the truly fused tool. A mix becomes a saved recipe + build brief â a builder still implements the real thing.

tools.label: Moor Ultra OS
tools.what_it_does: The build-anything stream: say what you want, scenes land.
tools.honest_limits: V1: scene previews are seeded 2D procedural renders naming real components â not the full 3D tools. Ingredients deep-link to component tools; dev spec editing is live.

tools.label: Creature Lab
tools.what_it_does: Stage A: end-to-end procedural walker.
tools.component_source: new: Creature Lab (handoff v1.0 Stage A)
tools.honest_limits: Stage A only: bilateral walkers (4/6 legs) on fixture terrain. Swimming, flight, climbing, burrowing, breeding, damage, ecosystems are planned (Stages B–G), explicitly not present.

tools.label: HoloPanel
tools.what_it_does: Laser-holo display screens â advertise, play video, show images.
tools.honest_limits: DOM component for now: it lives in page space, not world space. The 3D path (panel canvas → WebGL texture on a world quad) is specced in components/holopanel/SPEC.md, not yet built.

tools.label: MOOR canvas
tools.what_it_does: The MOOR workspace itself.

tools.what_it_does: The registry of shipped apps.

tools.label: Creation pipeline
tools.what_it_does: The production way MOOR builds apps.

tools.what_it_does: Verified reference software, not production.
tools.honest_limits: The compiler runs here as WebAssembly (bytes fetched from this site). Your thumbs up/down build a local log of how well it reads intent.

tools.what_it_does: Crunch every component into its real capabilities.
tools.honest_limits: First distillation pass is agentic judgment (new vs known vs marginal). distill.py re-runs the mechanical merge; judgment stays human.

tools.label: Redwood Drive
tools.what_it_does: Drive a buggy through a procedural redwood forest.
tools.honest_limits: Standalone experience embedding the live build. The component library (vehicle physics, model kit, maze, spawn) is documented for reuse; this is the showcase, not the library itself.

tools.label: Render Studio
tools.what_it_does: The 8-studio unified pipeline.
tools.honest_limits: Hub view only in this panel â the 8 studios run as their own Pulse tools. Full multi-file studio push is future work.

tools.label: Wonder Feed
tools.what_it_does: Infinite scroll through live generative wonders â now a creative instrument.
tools.honest_limits: Local-first v1: library, taste, and comments live in this browser. Share links encode the full genome in the URL hash.

tools.label: Vehicle physics lab
tools.what_it_does: Tune arcade car physics live, then feel the difference.
tools.honest_limits: The stepVehicle core is verbatim. Coast drag, handbrake strength, and quadratic air drag are extra exposed knobs (defaults reproduce the original exactly). The lot, cones, skid marks, telemetry, and presets are panel code.

tools.label: Idea Funnel
tools.what_it_does: Quiz your way to a build-ready master doc for a new component.
tools.honest_limits: The quiz, scoring rubric, and doc templates are panel code. It reads the live component catalog for part-picking. The "automation" is the build brief: paste it to your builder and the component gets built.

tools.label: Moor Beta
tools.what_it_does: The persistent world shell. Build a city, draw paths, claim land, walk it â on a real planet.
tools.honest_limits: Terrain is still the shell’s own (Planet Workshop terrain bridge next); vegetation is shell-native scatter, not the Living Garden Lab engine yet; building editing is whole-building (theme/stories/size), not wall-by-wall.

tools.label: The Vault
tools.what_it_does: Every asset you’ve made, in one place. Keep, iterate, or trash.
tools.honest_limits: Reads the asset stores it knows about (queue studio favorites, saved wonders, canvas parts, funnel docs); a tool with a brand-new storage format appears only after its reader is added.

tools.label: .moor.json model loader
tools.what_it_does: Turn model files into Three.js objects.

tools.label: Procedural modeling kit
tools.what_it_does: Code-built 3D models.

tools.label: Seeded maze layout
tools.what_it_does: Endless maze with collision, no 3D deps.

tools.label: Spawn station system
tools.what_it_does: Pure spawn data + circular warp math.

tools.label: Vehicle builder
tools.what_it_does: Build procedural vehicles, then test-drive them.
tools.honest_limits: No THREE.js in this page â the recovered builders run against a minimal geometry/material shim (Group, Mesh, primitives, MeshStandardMaterial) on one small WebGL renderer: no shadows, no textures, one light. The parameter layer (paint/wheels/tank/bars/cage/spoiler) and the buggy body are new panel code; the physics is verbatim.

tools.label: Furniture foundry
tools.what_it_does: Procedural furniture and common items â actually good-looking.
tools.honest_limits: No THREE.js â minimal geometry/material shim on one small WebGL renderer (from the vehicle builder pattern), upgraded with wood-grain/fabric-weave fragment shading and hemisphere studio lighting. Ground shadow is a CSS blob; no real shadow mapping.

tools.label: Billboard system
tools.what_it_does: Canvas sprites for signs and leaderboards.

tools.label: Tablet UI painters
tools.what_it_does: Canvas 2D UI, data-driven.

tools.honest_limits: Pure functions â the stream viewer and noise-field painter are panel code around the real mulberry32/hash/makeNoise.

tools.label: Seed codes
tools.what_it_does: Short codes that capture a full setup.
tools.honest_limits: The demo controls table is panel-defined; codeOf/parseCode/remixConfig are the real component.

tools.label: Seed console
tools.what_it_does: The standard generation bar.
tools.honest_limits: The console mounts to its own page by design, so it runs in a frame here against a demo studio. The console itself is verbatim.

tools.label: Autosave
tools.what_it_does: Autosave that survives corruption.
tools.honest_limits: The demo app (clicks + note) is panel code; the save manager is the real component on its own save slot.

tools.what_it_does: Verify before you announce.
tools.honest_limits: The gate is a Python script and cannot run in this page â its real gates are presented as a runnable checklist.

tools.label: Catalog checker
tools.what_it_does: Keeps the catalog honest.
tools.honest_limits: The check logic runs here against this page’s own inventory â the scan/build halves need a repo checkout and stay in Node.

tools.label: Safe file editing
tools.what_it_does: Edits only what it verified first.
tools.honest_limits: The protocol runs here against a demo document; the hash precondition and refusal behavior are the real logic.

tools.label: Safe uploads
tools.what_it_does: Look before you leap.
tools.honest_limits: The real Drive adapter runs against a pretend Drive (mock SDK honoring its sealed contract).

tools.label: MOOR Whole Blueprint
tools.what_it_does: Audit the offer, expand cards, edit dependencies, insert responsibilities, reconnect removals and export complete context for the next version.
tools.honest_limits: 645-card audited proposal. Device-local editor; generated references are mechanism examples. Physical PC/phone integration is unverified.
